text: A Convovo study made Grok 4.7 and GPT-6.1 Sol name one candidate in nearly 500 midterm races through their APIs. Grok picked the Republican 92% of the time and GPT the Democrat 97%, TechCrunch reports. OpenAI says ChatGPT itself declines to pick.
